news.words: LaPorta was a non-participant at Wednesday's practice due to a back injury. If he isn't able to participate Thursday or Friday, he could be at risk of missing his first contest of the campaign.
LaPorta (back) didn't practice Thursday. He has yet to mix into any drills this week, leaving him just one more chance to do so Friday.
LaPorta (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Philadelphia. LaPorta handled his normal workload in last week's 44-22 win at Washington, but he didn't practice at all this week.
Sam LaPorta (back) has been placed on injured reserve by the Detroit Lions. He will now be sidelined for at least the next four games.

news.words: Asked whether LaPorta could return this season: "Hopeful, but I really don't know." "Obviously, we're gonna hope that this thing calms down, and after those four games we can get him back."

news.words: LaPorta (back) has undergone surgery, and head coach Dan Campbell described LaPorta's chances of returning this season as "very, very slim" Friday. Campbell didn't completely shut the door on him returning.

news.source: CBS Sports (Dan Campbell, Friday press conference)
news.words: Campbell told reporters Friday that LaPorta "had a procedure," and that he's going "to be out for awhile." He did say that the procedure went well.
